_concepto: Primer video del género recap (estructura `recap`, 4 minutos, vertical), hecho como RECETA replicable: historia melodramática original en primera persona — Lucía cuenta cómo su padre, un mecánico al que toda la cuadra llamó «el loco del carbón», vendió el taller y gastó todo en carbón y latas una semana antes de una ola de frío polar sin precedentes que dejó a la provincia sin luz tres semanas; los que se rieron terminan viviendo en su casa. Método: el GUION COMPLETO se escribió primero (41 líneas, ~3.500 caracteres, a 14-16 cps para la voz de Kate) y cada plano ilustra su línea. Voz continua de punta a punta, que actúa los diálogos. Caras permitidas en planos medios; primeros planos sólo en tres momentos. Todo planos sueltos, sin cadenas.
_voz_nota: narradora = Kate (16,7 cps medidos, la más rápida de las voces en castellano de la cuenta; Marlene 14,9, Julieta 13,4). Los diálogos van con comillas latinas «» y los actúa la misma voz por puntuación, sin tags. Si al medir alguna línea pasa de 1,15×, se reescribe entera conservando el dato (regla 40).
_post: Subtítulos QUEMADOS en el máster (el SRT que genera el módulo, frase por frase). Textos en pantalla declarados en `texto`. Música: musica.mp3 (240 s). Mezcla con montaje.mezclar como en los otros.
estilo_imagen: Photorealistic prestige TV drama footage, an Argentine suburban town hit by an impossible polar cold wave: heavy snow where snow never falls, frost on brick walls and car windows, breath visible, dead blue-grey daylight outside against warm tungsten and firelight inside. Shot on 35mm with shallow depth of field, film grain, natural performances.
estilo_video: Photorealistic prestige drama footage in a snowbound Argentine suburb during an extreme cold wave, vertical 9:16. Natural, restrained movement.
cierre_video: Keep the framing of the first frame. Grainy, cinematic, photographic. Not animated, not illustrated, not CGI-looking, not a video game.
solo_sonidos: the wind, the snow, the coal stove and the house

planos.funcion: HOOK. El absurdo literal: un hombre arriba de una montaña de carbón con una pala, y vecinos filmándolo.
planos.ve: WIDE SHOT from the street of the snowy yard, vertical frame. Ramón stands on top of a mountain of coal taller than the fence, shovel in hand, in his navy work overall and grey beanie, breath steaming. Blue tarps half pulled off the pile. Two neighbours at the wire fence with phones raised, filming him. Grey dead sky, snow on everything.
planos.mueve: Ramón drives the shovel into the coal and throws a load down without looking at the neighbours. One neighbour laughs and elbows the other, phone still up. Snow drifts across the frame.
planos.audio: [Foley] a shovel biting into coal, coal rattling down. [Ambient] cold wind, a distant dog. [SFX] a phone camera shutter sound.

planos.funcion: ARRANQUE. La narradora en su mundo normal: la oficina, la ciudad, antes de todo.

planos.mueve: She types, glances at the frost on the glass, frowns a little, and goes back to the screen. The office lights flicker once. Her phone on the desk lights up.
planos.audio: [Ambient] office hum, keyboards, a distant phone. [SFX] fluorescent lights buzzing, one flicker. [Foley] a phone vibrating on a desk.

planos.funcion: ARRANQUE. El llamado del padre. La voz actúa el diálogo.
planos.ve: CLOSE UP of Lucía INSIDE the office, still seated at her desk, holding the phone to her ear, vertical frame. Behind her, out of focus, the office's glass wall with frost creeping in from the corners and the grey city beyond, desks and monitors around her. Her face goes from routine to alarm. The phone screen glow on her cheek. Indoor fluorescent light, no snow falling on her.
planos.mueve: She listens, her expression hardening, and stands up mid-sentence, grabbing her coat off the chair. Behind her, out of focus, coworkers keep working.
planos.audio: [Foley] a phone against an ear, a chair rolling back. [Ambient] the office. [SFX] faint through the phone: wind and a man's voice, unintelligible.

planos.funcion: ARRANQUE. La decisión visible: deja la reunión y se va.
planos.ve: AMERICAN SHOT of Lucía walking fast down the office aisle toward the elevators, vertical frame, pulling on the grey coat, phone still at her ear, bag over her shoulder. Coworkers turning their heads. Through the glass wall, the sky has gone the wrong colour.
planos.mueve: She strides toward camera, zipping the coat, hits the elevator button hard, and looks back once at the glass wall where the frost has spread. The elevator opens and she is gone.
planos.audio: [Foley] fast heels on office floor, a coat zipping, an elevator chime. [Ambient] office murmur rising as people notice.

planos.mueve: He draws the line, steps back, and measures the gap between the marks with his thumb and finger. He looks at the pile, then at the sky, and puts the chalk in his pocket.
planos.audio: [Foley] chalk on brick, a slow exhale. [Ambient] morning wind, snow, a distant shout from the house.

planos.funcion: BLOQUE 4 · cliffhanger. Un vecino quiere doble ración. Mi padre le da la pala: «El que más come, más carga».
planos.ve: MEDIUM SHOT in the crowded back room, vertical frame: Ramón standing, holding out a coal shovel handle-first toward a man out of focus in the foreground, his face calm and hard, firelight on his beard. People on the mattresses watching. Marta behind him with the pot.
planos.mueve: He holds the shovel out steadily and does not lower it. After a beat the man's hand comes into frame and takes it. Ramón nods once and turns back to the stove. Someone on a mattress exhales.
planos.audio: [Ambient] a tense room gone quiet, the stove. [Foley] a wooden shovel handle changing hands, a mattress creaking.

planos.funcion: BLOQUE 5. La noche once: la tormenta grande, cuarenta y dos bajo cero, la nieve tapa la chimenea.
planos.ve: EXTREME WIDE SHOT of the house at night in a violent blizzard, vertical frame: snow blasting horizontally, the yard and the coal pile buried, the roof a white mound, and the metal chimney pipe half swallowed by a drift, its smoke choking and blowing back down. One faint orange window. Nothing else visible in the white.
planos.mueve: The blizzard hammers the house. The drift climbs the chimney pipe until the smoke stops coming out and curls back down under the eave. The orange window flickers.
planos.audio: [Ambient] a blizzard at full force, screaming wind. [SFX] snow hissing against brick, metal groaning. [Foley] the chimney's draw choking to a stop.
planos._nota_vram: bajado de 7,3 a 6,6 s el 31/8: a 7,3 no entró en 32 GB ni con ComfyUI fresco (OOM x9)

planos.funcion: BLOQUE 5. El humo vuelve a la pieza. Treinta y dos personas, una salida. Monóxido.
planos.ve: CLOSE UP on the joint of the coal stove pipe near the ceiling, vertical frame: grey smoke leaking back OUT of the seam and pooling under the ceiling instead of going up. Below, out of focus, the crowded room, people's faces turning up toward it, a candle.
planos.mueve: The smoke thickens at the seam and spreads across the ceiling in a slow layer. Someone below starts coughing, then another. A hand waves at the air uselessly.
planos.audio: [SFX] the stove's draw gone wrong, a hollow puffing. [Foley] coughing, one, then several, a child crying. [Ambient] the blizzard outside, muffled.

planos.funcion: BLOQUE 5. Tomi se ata una soga y sube al techo. Mi madre no grita porque no puede.
planos.ve: AMERICAN SHOT at the back door of the house in the blizzard, vertical frame: Tomi in his black puffer with the red beanie pulled low, a rope tied around his waist, one foot already on a ladder against the wall, snow blasting past him horizontally. A flashlight from the doorway lights his back. His hands are bare.
planos.mueve: He climbs three rungs, the wind shoving him against the ladder, and hauls himself up onto the snow-buried roof edge. The rope goes taut behind him. The flashlight beam follows him up and loses him in the white.
planos.audio: [Ambient] the blizzard screaming. [Foley] boots on metal rungs, a rope scraping brick. [SFX] a woman's voice shouting a name once, lost in the wind.

planos.funcion: BLOQUE 5. En el techo, destapa la chimenea a mano en la ventisca. Cuatro minutos. Bajó con los dedos blancos.
planos.ve: WIDE SHOT on the snow-buried roof in the blizzard, vertical frame: Tomi on his knees in the drift, red beanie, black puffer white with snow, digging with his bare hands around the half-buried chimney pipe, the rope trailing behind him into the white. Horizontal snow. No sky, no ground, only white and him.
planos.mueve: He claws snow away from the pipe in fast desperate handfuls, gets his arm down the drift, and yanks — a plug of snow comes free and grey smoke bursts up out of the pipe into the wind. He falls back into the snow, then grabs the rope.
planos.audio: [Ambient] the blizzard. [Foley] hands digging in packed snow, gasping, a heavy exhale. [SFX] the chimney's draw roaring back to life.

planos.funcion: BLOQUE 5. Don Beto lo abraza como si fuera su hijo. No lo suelta.
planos.ve: MEDIUM SHOT in the back room, vertical frame: Don Beto in his leather jacket holding Tomi in a hard embrace, Tomi's red beanie soaked, snow melting off his black puffer onto the floor, his white fingers pressed against Beto's back. The stove glowing again behind them, the smoke gone. Faces around them in the firelight.
planos.mueve: Beto grips the back of Tomi's head and does not let go. Tomi's shoulders shake once. Marta comes in from the side and wraps a blanket around both of them together.
planos.audio: [Ambient] the room breathing again, the stove drawing clean. [Foley] wet fabric, a blanket, a stifled sob. [SFX] the blizzard outside, still there.
planos._nota_vram: bajado a 5,9 s el 31/8: OOM persistente en el host 2 incluso con proceso fresco

planos.funcion: BLOQUE 5 · cliffhanger. Esa noche nadie durmió. Mi padre midió la pila: la mitad.
planos.ve: CLOSE UP on Ramón's hand holding a flashlight against the coal pile at night in the blizzard, vertical frame, the beam showing the pile now at half the height of the chalk marks on the wall beside it. Snow in the beam. His overall sleeve crusted white.
planos.mueve: The beam travels slowly up the chalk marks to the highest one, far above the pile now, and holds there. The hand shakes slightly with cold. The flashlight clicks off.
planos.audio: [Foley] a flashlight clicking, snow in the wind. [Ambient] the blizzard, slightly weaker. [SFX] coal shifting under snow.

planos.funcion: PAGO. El día veintidós salió el sol. Nadie en nuestra casa murió. En la provincia, cientos.
planos.ve: EXTREME WIDE SHOT of the neighbourhood at sunrise after the storm, vertical frame: a low pale sun on a white silent world, houses buried to the windows, bare trees crusted with ice glittering, and at the end of the street one chimney smoking straight up into still air. Very long shadows on the snow.
planos.mueve: The sun clears the rooftops and the ice on the trees flares gold all at once. A door opens somewhere down the street and a small figure steps out into the snow and just stands there. The chimney smokes straight up.
planos.audio: [Ambient] total stillness, no wind for the first time, a drip of melting ice. [SFX] a single bird. [Foley] a door creaking open far away.

planos.funcion: PAGO. Llega el ejército: treinta y dos personas vivas en la casa del loco del carbón.
planos.ve: WIDE SHOT from the street of the house in sunlight, vertical frame: an olive-green army truck stopped at the gate with soldiers climbing down, and in the yard a crowd of about thirty people in blankets coming out of the house into the sun, blinking, children running in the snow. On the porch, Ramón in his overall with Marta and Lucía beside him, not moving.
planos.mueve: Soldiers open the gate and the crowd flows out toward the truck. A soldier counts heads with a raised hand. Ramón stays on the porch; Marta takes his arm; Lucía looks at her father.
planos.audio: [Ambient] a crowd in daylight, voices, children. [Foley] a truck idling, boots, a gate. [SFX] a soldier's whistle.

planos.funcion: PAGO. Don Beto se le para enfrente, borra el video, y le pide perdón.
planos.ve: CLOSE UP of Don Beto facing Ramón in the yard in sunlight, vertical frame, Beto in profile in the foreground holding his phone up between them with the screen toward Ramón, Ramón's face beyond, calm. Beto's moustache trembling. Snow bright behind them.
planos.mueve: Beto's thumb presses the screen once, deliberately, and he lowers the phone. He says something short and his eyes fill. Ramón looks at him for a long beat, then puts a big hand on the back of his neck and pulls him in.
planos.audio: [Foley] a phone tap, a jacket creaking, a hand on a neck. [Ambient] the yard, the crowd farther away, dripping ice.

planos.funcion: PAGO. Reencuadre del gancho: la pila casi vacía, la pala clavada. Quedaban dos días. Justo.
planos.ve: CLOSE UP of the coal pile in sunlight, vertical frame — now just a low black heap in a wide dark stain of coal dust on the snow, the shovel standing upright in it. On the brick wall behind, the column of chalk marks runs from far above down to almost the ground. Blue tarps folded on the snow.
planos.mueve: The shovel handle casts a long shadow that creeps across the black heap as the sun rises. A crow lands on the wall by the chalk marks and looks down. Melting ice drips off the tarp.
planos.audio: [Ambient] morning stillness, dripping. [SFX] a crow. [Foley] a tarp shifting.

planos.funcion: BUCLE. Mi padre mira el cielo: el próximo invierno va a ser peor. Y ya empezó a comprar.
planos.ve: MEDIUM SHOT of Ramón standing in the yard, vertical frame, in his navy overall and grey beanie, looking up at the sky where grey clouds are gathering again beyond the sun, a notebook and pencil in his hand. Behind him the low remains of the coal pile and a new pallet of canned food.
planos.mueve: He watches the clouds build, writes a number in the notebook, and closes it. He does not look worried. He looks like a man making a list. A single flake lands on the page.
planos.audio: [Ambient] a breeze rising, dripping slowing. [Foley] a pencil on paper, a notebook closing. [SFX] very far, thunder or a truck.

planos.funcion: BUCLE. La casa desde la calle — y en tres veredas más, ahora, vecinos descargando carbón. Corte a negro. «¿Vos le creerías?»
planos.ve: EXTREME WIDE SHOT of the neighbourhood street in late daylight after the thaw has begun, vertical frame: our brick house with its yard at the end, and in front of THREE other houses along the street, small trucks unloading coal into yards, neighbours with shovels, new tarps. Grey clouds gathering overhead again.
planos.mueve: Coal pours from a truck bed into a yard. A neighbour looks up at the clouds, then back at his pile, and keeps shovelling. The clouds thicken over the street. The frame cuts to black.
planos.audio: [Foley] coal rattling from a truck, shovels. [Ambient] a street alive again, voices, a rising wind. [SFX] the first gust of the next storm, then cut to silence.

voz.texto: Mi padre vendió el taller y gastó todo en carbón. Toda la cuadra se le rió.
Tres días después, se cortó la luz en toda la provincia.
Un martes me llamó a la oficina: «Lucía, buscá a tu hermano y vengan ya».
«Papá, tengo una reunión.» «Que se joda. El tanque reventó de hielo en media hora.»
En la ruta pasaban autos importados sin patente, a toda velocidad. Los que saben, ya se iban.
Tomi se rió: «Papá otra vez con el fin del mundo». Yo no me reí.
En el patio había una montaña de carbón, doscientas latas y la camioneta vieja llena de garrafas.
Mi padre nos mostró un balde: doce gorriones duros como piedra. «Los junté esta mañana.»
«¿Cuánta plata tenés, Lucía?» «Trescientos mil.» «Va todo a comida. La plata sirve si estamos vivos.»
Del otro lado de la reja, Don Beto filmaba para el grupo del barrio: «el loco del carbón».
Un millón doscientos en dos días: comida, remedios, pilas. Y carbón.
La primera noche marcó dieciocho bajo cero. Récord histórico.
Mi padre había armado una sola pieza caliente: la del fondo, con la salamandra y colchones en el piso.
Afuera, el barrio seguía normal. Luces prendidas, tele, estufas eléctricas a full.
La segunda noche marcó treinta y uno bajo cero. Y a las tres de la mañana, se cortó la luz.
Todo el barrio negro. Toda la provincia. Y en el fondo de casa, una chimenea humeando.
A las cuatro golpearon la puerta: el hijo de Don Beto, doce años, sin campera.
«¿Y tu papá?» «No sé.» Mi padre lo metió adentro sin decir nada.
Una hora después llegó Don Beto con la mujer y la nena. No filmaba. Temblaba.
Tres reglas: «Nadie sale. Nadie desperdicia. Y nadie pide perdón todavía.»
La radio dijo lo que mi padre sabía hace una semana: la ola iba a durar tres semanas.
En la ciudad reventaron los caños: sin agua, sin luz, sin gas. El ejército no podía entrar.
Pensé en mi departamento, en el piso once. Sin ascensor. Sin nada.
Al tercer día había veinte personas en la reja. Al cuarto, treinta y dos.
Mi padre abrió la reja con una condición: entra la familia entera, o no entra nadie.
Mi madre cocinaba para todos: una olla de arroz a la mañana, guiso de lata a la noche.
Tomi y Don Beto se turnaban la pala del carbón. Ninguno de los dos hablaba del video.
Mi padre medía la pila cada mañana con una marca en la pared. Y cada mañana la marca bajaba.
Un vecino quiso doble ración para su familia. Mi padre le dio la pala: «El que más come, más carga.»
La noche once vino la tormenta grande. Cuarenta y dos bajo cero. La nieve tapó la chimenea.
El humo volvió. Treinta y dos personas, una salida. Monóxido.
Tomi se ató una soga y subió al techo. Mi madre no gritó porque no podía.
Tardó cuatro minutos en destapar la chimenea a mano. Bajó con los dedos blancos. Pero bajó.
Don Beto lo abrazó como si fuera su hijo. Después no lo soltó por un rato largo.
Esa noche no durmió nadie. Mi padre midió la pila: quedaba la mitad.
El día veintidós salió el sol. En nuestra casa no murió nadie. En la provincia, cientos.
Cuando llegó el ejército, encontraron treinta y dos personas vivas en la casa del loco del carbón.
Don Beto se le paró enfrente, borró el video, y le pidió perdón.
Quedaban dos días de carbón. Justo.
Mi padre dice que el próximo invierno va a ser peor. Y ya empezó a comprar.
¿Vos le creerías?
